items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Willie Humphrey — you know of him? The clarinet player? Willie Humphrey? ... Willie talked to my grandfather about getting my dad an instrument.

ctx.x: Wow. How much documentation do you have on it, anything?

Not much. It’s hard to even comment on stuff like that because it’s so difficult to find information on that. But we have people re-writing history every day all of a sudden now. They’re taking things that they can’t really prove, that’s kind of rumors and stuff like that, and documenting it as the truth, and that’s a little bit scary. So it’s hard — you know this is like what my old Uncle Willie had told like my mother and them when they were kids, how they got to New Orleans. But it’s not documented so this is…
And they had no idea that they were perhaps part of making some musical history, they were just working.
